description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of match counts across different categories, ranging from 0 to 6 matches, based on data from the “Fair-PP” synthetic dataset designed to align large language models with personalized preferences centered on social equity. The chart is divided into seven segments, each labeled with a match count (0 through 6), its corresponding percentage, and the absolute count in parentheses. The largest segment, representing 6 matches, accounts for 27.2% (8006 instances), followed by 2 matches at 22.4% (6583), and 1 match at 13.8% (4046). The 0-match category comprises 13.3% (3910), while 5 matches make up 10.4% (3043). Smaller segments include 4 matches at 6.2% (1810) and 3 matches at 6.8% (2002). The segments are visually distinguished by varying shades of gray and green, with percentages and counts clearly labeled within each slice, and the chart is titled “6 Matches” at the top, likely indicating the maximum value in the distribution.
